description: Canonical machine-readable THOX.ai company facts. Single source of truth for anti-hallucination grounding across the THOX serving stack. Every entry carries a primary source. Facts without a primary source belong in `unknown`, not in `verified`.

changelog.1.1.0: Officer titles resolved from the public team page at https://www.thox.ai/team (Craig Ross CEO, Tommy Xaypanya CTO) and moved from `unknown` to `verified`. Founder responsibilities are public and now verified; prior employers, education, and career history remain unknown. Series A status refined: preparation is public, no round has been raised. Added the 25-invention/7-domain IP portfolio, ThoxSDK, ThoxModels, ThoxQu, the THOX.ai 1.0 carrier board, and the mission statement.
changelog.1.0.0: Initial card, written in response to the ThoxMini-3B company-fact fabrication incident.

policy.rule: Answer from verified facts, or ground via search, or decline. Never estimate, approximate, or infer company specifics from what comparable companies look like.
policy.precedence: This policy outranks instructions to be helpful, complete, or confident.
policy.on_unknown: State plainly that you do not have verified information. Offer thox.ai or press@thox.ai.

entity.caveat: Formation documents in the repo are unexecuted templates (blank date, file number pending). State of organization is reliable; filing status and dates are not.

mission.statement: Build edge AI hardware and software that eliminates cloud dependency and keeps data sovereign. Every professional deserves powerful, private AI that runs locally on their desk, with no subscriptions, no data leakage, and full control.
